headline: CTO OS: Expert CTO Skills for Claude
short_description: **Transform Claude into your expert CTO advisor** with 4 professional skills covering architecture decisions, engineering metrics, technology roadmaps, and risk management.
author: rinaldofesta

sections.overview:
CTO OS is a collection of 4 expert Claude Skills designed for CTOs and engineering leaders. The skills embed proven methodologies across architecture decisions, DORA metrics implementation, strategic technology roadmaps, and risk management. Each skill provides frameworks, templates, and guidance for critical leadership decisions—from evaluating tech stacks and creating Architecture Decision Records to setting up engineering KPIs, aligning technology with business strategy, and conducting security audits. Engineering leaders use these skills to systematically document decisions, measure team performance, plan strategic initiatives, and manage organizational risk.
Create Architecture Decision Records for database and framework selections
Set up DORA metrics and KPIs for engineering performance tracking
Build multi-quarter technology roadmaps aligned with business goals
Conduct security audits and compliance planning for SOC 2 certification

sections.usage:

```
Act as my CTO advisor with the following skills: 1) Architecture Decision Making, 2) Engineering Metrics Analysis, 3) Technology Roadmap Development, and 4) Risk Management. I'm [COMPANY], a [INDUSTRY] company. Based on [DATA], help me [SPECIFIC TASK].
```
